cases.requirement: Start through the candidate's own launcher and verify its source/config binding; backend and page must both report ready.

Fresh setup offers native Codex without CLI/SDK downloads; existing native account, Provider and model stay selected. No third-party model is prefilled. Connecting a CLI lists unverified candidates separately; only a user-selected model that passes the consented short inference appears.
The visible engine and model must match the engine and model recorded for the submitted turn.

Existing chats lock engine/source. Only compatible, explicitly enabled models may be selected; Apply preserves history and routes the next turn to the acknowledged selection. A failed switch preserves the committed model.
When the official account/model offers speed options, Standard/Fast uses the host action, is acknowledged, and persists when reopened. CLI engines do not show the native speed setting.
Complete a real short reply and retain a fresh nonce for continuation checks.
Approve one exact file write in the isolated acceptance workspace and verify its exact contents.
Reject a different file write and verify that file was not created.
Cancel an active turn from the real UI; observe terminal cancelled/interrupted state and no late successful reply.
Quit and reopen the actual desktop through the candidate launcher, then continue the same chat and recover its nonce without resupplying it.
Verify the native Codex chat, existing sidebar and a previously available plugin remain usable.
Quit the enhanced client and open the official app normally; verify stock operation without deleting chats or credentials.

evidenceRules: Manual UI results require an explicit user report for the exact case; process liveness and catalog discovery are insufficient.
Runtime and filesystem observations must be bound to the exact candidate digest, configuration and dedicated test chats.
Never upload private profiles, credentials, raw personal logs or unrelated chats as release evidence.
A failed or pending case prevents stable publication.
